{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display first few rows and info
print(sales_df.head())
print('\nData types:')
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:')
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in 'customer_segment' and 'order_status'
print('\nUnique customer segments:')
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())

print('\nUnique order statuses:')
print(sales_df['order_status'].unique())

# Check if 'revenue' column exists
print('\nColumns in data:')
print(sales_df.columns)

# Check if 'LOYAL' is in customer_segment
loyal_in_data = 'LOYAL' in sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()
print(f'\nIs "LOYAL" a valid customer segment? {loyal_in_data}')

# Check if there are completed orders
completed_in_status = 'completed' in sales_df['order_status'].unique()
print(f'\nAre there completed orders? {completed_in_status}')

# Check if 'revenue' column exists
revenue_exists = 'revenue' in sales_df.columns
print(f'\nIs "revenue" a column in the data? {revenue_exists}')"}
